title: Minigame: C9 Mortars

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the C9 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): the fewest counters C9.1, C9.2, C9.4, and A21.13 need, on an imported board.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): the units are set up by hand, the German 50mm light mortar [2-13] with a squad, Russian targets at range 1 and 2 with a truck in one target hex, and a lone German leader with a second light mortar, in the PFPh.

introduction: A light mortar and its squad fire at targets at and inside its minimum range; a lone leader fires the second one.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
